simple.meaning: מֶתֶק (metheq) is a Hebrew word meaning “figuratively, pleasantness (of discourse).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: מֶתֶק (H4986) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Proverbs 16:21, with occurrences in Proverbs.

simple.summary: מֶתֶק (metheq) / H4986 is traced through Proverbs 16:21, Proverbs 27:9 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H4986. metheq מֶ֫תֶק noun masculine Prov 16:21 sweetness ; construct ׳מ שְׂפָתַיִם 16:21 i.e. agreeable, attractive speech, so probably ׳מ רֵעֵהוּ 27:9 the sweetness of one's friend , i.e. of his speech.
